errors.evidence: The description states the development of relevance of satisfaction in three life areas, but it does not explicitly mention that the chart shows area satisfaction measures and their relevance as labeled in the figure/caption in a neutral description of what is displayed.
The description omits the exact y-axis label text visible in the figure: 'Maß für Relevanz (Spearman-Korrelation)'. It also does not explicitly state the x-axis is the horizontal axis in the figure.
The description does not mention the legend layout beneath the plot or that the three colored series are displayed as grouped bars within each year category.

The figure and caption show the development from 2022 to 2025, while the chart image itself only visibly includes 2022 and 2024. The description commits to 2022–2024 as the overall period, which does not match the figure caption.
